verdict.rationale: As merchant of record, Paddle documents that it 'calculates, collects, and remits taxes for you' across 200+ countries with no extra engineering. Supporting evidence includes localized prices with estimated taxes, tax rates and tax mode in reconciliation reports, and a community user citing EU VAT handling as the main draw. One community report describes a support-issued UK VAT invoice with the wrong VAT number and currency; that is a manual invoicing error, not a concrete contradiction of automatic tax calculation, so it lowers quality only. Missing for 10: detailed docs on calculation mechanics (tax-inclusive vs. exclusive pricing, B2B reverse charge or exemptions, US sales-tax specifics), and independent hands-on verification that calculated amounts are correct.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically

citations.quote: As a merchant of record, Paddle calculates, collects, and remits taxes for you.
Go global and sell in over 200 countries and territories, fully tax compliant, with no extra engineering effort
Build pricing pages that show customers prices localized for their country and currency — including estimated taxes and discounts.
include tax rates and tax mode to prove local compliance
Big draw was 'tax management' handling EU VAT unlike Stripe/Chargebee.
